text:
Introduction
This document lists the
equipment inspection, which must be performed on an annually bases bases as indicated by Y1
in the above title block
This 
checklist for the operating mechanism of the Power/Vac vacuum circuit breaker 
type: VB 13.8-1000, rated voltage 11.5kv, maximum voltage 15kv, nominal 
interrupting capacity: 1000MVA.
The first draft initiated by eng. Saleh El-Sayed Saleh and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez,
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Safety and healthy 
 tools must be used as safety Helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Generator isolation and proper earthling is required
Circuit breaker disconnects and secondary disconnects and
 ground shoe
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Digital voltmeter, Megger, Brushes.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the mating surfaces of the metal-clad.
Check the racking mechanism to make certain that it is
 in the disconnect position.
Check the voltage control at the source of power and
 line drop between the power source and breaker.
Check closing and
 opening times.
- 3 cycle breaker 
0.25 to 0.30 Sec.
b. Initiation of close
 signal to control closing:
 - Standard breaker 
0.60 to 0. 1 Sec.
 - Fast bus transformer breaker 0. 60
to 0. 1 Sec.
- Instantaneous reclose time 0. 128 to 0.221 Sec
The primary circuit insulation on the breaker may be
 checked phase to phase to ground using a 2500V megohmeter.
A resistance check of the primary circuit may be made with
 the breaker-closed use a low resistance-measuring instrument, which measures
 microhms.
Vacuum interrupter integrity test .
Check the erosion indicator and wipe gap.
Lubricate the breaker operating mechanism.
Check the electrical operation using test cabinet ( if
 available ) or the test position in the metal clad switchgear.
Examine the movable contact rod of the vacuum interrupter with the breaker
 open and wipe the lubricant off the rod and examine the silver surface.
